top_signals.title: Bot Auto taps Lenovo, Nvidia, pegs autonomy hardware at $50,000
top_signals.summary:
Bot Auto will put Lenovo’s AD1 domain controller in its driverless Class 8 trucks starting in Q1 2027, part of a push toward 1 billion autonomous miles by 2031

top_signals.title: Shell Slams Australia's Plan to Force LNG Producers to Supply Domestic Market
top_signals.summary: Shell has spoken out against a plan by the Australian government to ensure domestic gas supply by mandating LNG producers to reserve certain volumes of their output for domestic use. “Fundamentally, it's a sledgehammer to crack a nut. And it is an extraordinarily heavy-handed intervention into a market that is actually working well,” Shell Australia’s chairwoman, Cecile Wake, said at an industry event in Australia, as quoted by Reuters.
